payment_allocations_one_document_check.name: payment_allocations_one_document_check
payment_allocations_one_document_check.value: (case when "payment_allocations"."repair_order_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end + case when "payment_allocations"."sale_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end + case when "payment_allocations"."purchase_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end + case when "payment_allocations"."operating_expense_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end + case when "payment_allocations"."purchase_line_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end + case when "payment_allocations"."repair_expense_id" is not null then 1 else 0 end) = 1

purchase_lines_destination_check.name: purchase_lines_destination_check
purchase_lines_destination_check.value: ("purchase_lines"."destination" = 'inventory' and "purchase_lines"."repair_order_id" is null) or ("purchase_lines"."destination" = 'repair_direct' and "purchase_lines"."repair_order_id" is not null)
